brief.elevator_pitch: Santino's Pizza is a family owned and operated pizzeria in Parlin, NJ, serving hand-tossed pies since 1970.

sonic_logo.prompt: Brand mnemonic for Santino's Pizza (Family owned and operated since 1970.). A 4-second sonic logo in the spirit of the Netflix ta-dum or Intel bong: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming mood, warm, familial, unhurried, welcoming character. Opens with a soft attack, rises through two or three notes, resolves to a single warm chord that rings out cleanly. Ownable, hummable, unmistakable. No vocals, no speech.
sonic_logo.negative_prompt: vocals, speech, muddy mix, harsh noise, long fade

voice_logo.script: Welcome to Santino's Pizza. Family owned and operated since 1970.
voice_logo.voice_direction: Speak as the brand's own voice: warm, natural speaking voice. Tone: warm, familial, unhurried, welcoming. Unhurried, one breath, smile audible.

notification.prompt: Soft notification chime for Santino's Pizza: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming. A single gentle wooden knock followed by a warm muted tone, under one second, friendly not urgent.

success.prompt: Success confirm for Santino's Pizza: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming. Two rising notes resolving up, bright but soft, under 1.2 seconds.

error.prompt: Gentle error nudge for Santino's Pizza: warm acoustic, warm, welcoming. A single low rounded tone, no buzz, no harshness, under one second. Reassuring, not alarming.

music.note: Set FAL_API_KEY to generate sonic logos and UI sounds; until then the sonic_brand skill stages briefs + prompts.
